fusions.name: Arm Drumming
fusions.desc: Pounds the ground with eight arms, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Clamped Down
fusions.desc: Pins the target under the head for 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Boneless Squeeze
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Maularm
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded Maularm familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
